items.source:
Used as connection or client identifier to select the MCP client, the sampling
method is associated with.
items.translation: 用作连接或客户端标识符以选择与采样方法关联的 MCP 客户端。

items.source: For synchronous handlers, the method must return CreateMessageResult. For asynchronous handlers, the method must return Mono<CreateMessageResult>.
items.translation: 对于同步处理器，该方法必须返回CreateMessageResult。对于异步处理器，该方法必须返回Mono<CreateMessageResult>。

items.source:
Methods annotated with this annotation can be used to process sampling requests from
MCP servers. The methods can have one of two signatures:
items.translation: 带有此注解的方法可用于处理来自 MCP 服务器的采样请求。这些方法的签名可以是以下两种之一：
类型为 `CreateMessageRequest` 的单个参数

items.source: Multiple parameters corresponding to the fields of CreateMessageRequest
items.translation: 与 `CreateMessageRequest` 字段对应的多个参数

items.source:
Annotation for methods that handle sampling requests from MCP servers. This annotation
is applicable only for MCP clients.
items.translation: 用于处理来自 MCP 服务器的采样请求的方法注解。此注解仅适用于 MCP 客户端。

items.source:
• 类型为 `CreateMessageRequest` 的单个参数
  • 与 `CreateMessageRequest` 字段对应的多个参数
items.translation:
• 单个类型为 `CreateMessageRequest` 的参数
  • 多个与 `CreateMessageRequest` 字段对应的参数

items.source:
@McpSampling(clients = "test-client")
public CreateMessageResult handleSamplingRequest(CreateMessageRequest request) {
    // Process the request and return a result
    return CreateMessageResult.builder()
        .message("Generated response")
        .build();
}

@McpSampling(clients = "test-client")
public Mono<CreateMessageResult> handleAsyncSamplingRequest(CreateMessageRequest request) {
    // Process the request asynchronously and return a result
    return Mono.just(CreateMessageResult.builder()
        .message("Generated response")
        .build());
}
items.translation:
@McpSampling(clients = "test-client")
public CreateMessageResult handleSamplingRequest(CreateMessageRequest request) {
    // 处理请求并返回结果
    return CreateMessageResult.builder()
        .message("生成的响应")
        .build();
}

@McpSampling(clients = "test-client")
public Mono<CreateMessageResult> handleAsyncSamplingRequest(CreateMessageRequest request) {
    // 异步处理请求并返回结果
    return Mono.just(CreateMessageResult.builder()
        .message("生成的响应")
        .build());
}
